task: Creating a quick spray paint resist (with stencil)
query: How do I create a quick spray paint resist with a stencil?

goal.title: Create a spray-painted heart resist on paper
goal.description: Press a plastic cover sheet flat on the work surface and place a white paper sheet on top, then position a heart-shaped paper mask on the paper and secure its edges with strips of tape pulled from a roll and trimmed with scissors. Spray gold paint over the paper around the mask, peel the mask away to reveal a white heart shape, and trace a purple marker around its outline before adding a small mark below it.
goal.final_state: A white heart shape surrounded by gold spray paint remains on the paper, fully outlined in purple marker with a small mark added at the lower left; the final visible action is the marker lifting away from the paper.
procedure: Spread the protective plastic sheet and place white paper on it.
Position the heart-shaped mask on the paper.
Pull and cut tape to secure the mask.
Spray gold paint around the mask and lift the mask away.
Trace around the heart with the purple marker and add the small writing below it.

phases.description: Prepare the covered work surface and paper.
Position and tape the heart mask.
Outline the heart and add a small mark.
